steps.message: Delete the file backup_funny_zebra.mp4 from the Android filesystem located in the Movies folder within the sdk_gphone_x86_64 storage area.

Execute: adb shell "for p in /sdcard/Movies/backup_funny_zebra.mp4 /storage/emulated/0/Movies/backup_funny_zebra.mp4 /storage/self/primary/Movies/backup_funny_zebra.mp4; do if [ -e \"$p\" ]; then echo FOUND:$p; rm -f \"$p\"; fi; done; for p in /sdcard/Movies/backup_funny_zebra.mp4 /storage/emulated/0/Movies/backup_funny_zebra.mp4 /storage/self/primary/Movies/backup_funny_zebra.mp4; do if [ -e \"$p\" ]; then echo STILL_PRESENT:$p; fi; done; echo CHECK_COMPLETE"
